user.title: Heating schedule
user.description: Pick the thermostat to schedule. The schedule only sets the target temperature; the HVAC mode stays as it is.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a schedule.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the week schedule and/or turn it on or off.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Days mon…sun, each a list of points {time: "HH:MM", temp}. The first point of a day is at 00:00.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the schedule sets the target temperature.

import_scheduler.name: Import from Scheduler
import_scheduler.description: Create schedules from Scheduler component switches that call climate.set_temperature.

entity_id.name: Scheduler switches
entity_id.description: Switches to import. Default: all switch.schedule_*.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Overwrite days of thermostats that already have a schedule.

init.title: Presence
init.description: Presence entities: the room counts as occupied when any of them is on (person/device tracker: home). They feed the occupancy profile shown on the card. Away entities: the house counts as empty when none of them has been home for the delay. Unknown/unavailable states never count as absence.

data_description.empty_setback: Lower the target by this much when the room has been empty for the delay. 0 = off (worth it only with fast floor heating).
data_description.away_temperature: Cap the target at this temperature while everyone is away. Empty = off.
